## Triage: first grade · `priority:p1` · `domain:spec` · `target:v18` · `pm:queue` · land with PR #23418 · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T07:58Z

Read fresh, and checked on `main`: `page-header-subtitle-alias` (`conversions/registry.ts:4936`) and `inline-action-api-params-to-body-extra` (`:5581`) both read `toMajor: 17`, and neither carries `retiredFromLoadPath`.
- **p1 + `target:v18`, under the protocol-first rule.** Both answers change the protocol on the v18 line.
  - Retiring the two conversions from the load path at 18 narrows what every door accepts, consistently. It is overdue, since both are `retiresIn 18`.
  - Making the save door apply live-window conversions changes what that door accepts.
  - Either way it must be settled inside the 18 window.
- **Order:** PR #23418 (#23388, ruling B, draft) moves `validateComponentProps` onto the save door. Without this card, a page the CLI silently converts gets `422 component-props-unknown-key` at `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME`. This card lands **with or before** PR #23418, or #23418's claimant takes it into the same landing.
- **Lane `domain:spec`** (`packages/spec/src/conversions`). The ADR-0087 call is the owning seat's, as filed.

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (per dispatch-gates --tier: no path-derived mandate; floor · default · ceiling); review before the queue at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (a narrowing)`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/spec`'s two D2 conversions, declared `toMajor: 17` (window ends at 18) yet not `retiredFromLoadPath`, so the load path and `os validate` convert what the save door (after PR #23418) refuses | `retiredFromLoadPath` with the stored-row replay (`conversions/stored.ts` replays the full chain, retired entries included) is the existing path every other step-18 retirement takes | page authors who still spell `page:header` `description` or an inline `api` action's object `params`
Thread-read: 6163717752
Serial constraints cleared: open PR #23441 (this seat, card #23268, in the merge queue) also edits `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (it adds one conversion); different entries, ordinary concurrency, the later lander merges `main`. PR #23418 (this seat, card #23388) is the PR this card must land with or before (triage `6163717752`); it touches `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` and migration-entry text, not `conversions/registry.ts`.

Reading on `origin/main` `61b12584f` at 2026-10-14T09:32Z: both entries read `toMajor: 17` and carry no `retiredFromLoadPath`. Family reading (the seat's own parse of `registry.ts`, a lead, not an answer): 12 `toMajor: 17` entries lack the field; this card retires the two its finding names, and the dev lists the rest with a verdict each.
